contexts.text: The earth is defiled under its inhabitants ().
They who pervert and contaminate the holy and true things of faith by wanting to investigate them through knowledges and reasonings. Signified.
So long as they are in falsity they cannot be intromitted into heavenly Societies, for they would thereby contaminate them.
They are not goods so long as hereditary evil contaminates them...
The influx of celestial love from the Lord is then continually... contaminated...
When uncircumcised is joined to anything, it = the obscuring and contamination thereof.
To contaminate spiritual good by profaning it. Signified.
[Swedenborg footnote 1.] A judge who punishes the evil... lest the good be contaminated...
The good he then does is spurious good, which is inwardly contaminated by his evils.
Lasciviousnesses, which contaminate his marriage love.
Man's Natural is from birth contaminated with evils...
He was not allowed to contaminate his internal.
